name: Searing Coral
summary: Along the Wetlands coast, Searing Coral is gathered from living iron coral beneath the sea. Tinkerers and smiths prize its heat-resistant mineral for strengthening armor.

sections.title: A Rare coastal Resource
sections.body: Searing Coral grows in the cold sea south of Menethil Harbor. Living iron coral thrives in saltwater and yields mineral-rich material that withstands extreme heat. Harvesters must pry the hardened growths loose while wild murlocs and other aquatic beasts roam nearby.

sections.title: Application in Smithing
sections.body: Dwarven smiths do not traditionally work Searing Coral. In Ironforge, curious gnome craftsmen such as Klockmort Spannerspan follow methods from veteran armorsmith Furen Longbeard. They smelt the coral and hammer it into metal alloys, making lightweight, durable armor for aspiring warriors.

faq.answer: Searing Coral grows in iron coral beds beneath the shallow coastal waters south of Menethil Harbor in the Wetlands.

faq.q: Who wants Searing Coral in Ironforge?
faq.answer: Klockmort Spannerspan, a gnomish artificer in Ironforge's Tinkertown, seeks Searing Coral. He experiments with smithing methods learned from the legendary dwarven armorer Furen Longbeard.

faq.q: How can coral be forged into armor?
faq.answer: Searing Coral has an unusually dense, heat-resistant structure. Smelted in a forge and hammered into metal alloys, it strengthens the composite plating and makes exceptionally tough protective gear.

faq.q: Is Searing Coral dangerous to harvest?
faq.answer: The coral itself is safe to gather once found. Reaching it means swimming in open waters off the Wetlands coast, where wild murlocs and aggressive aquatic beasts roam.

angles.text: As a warrior, gathering Searing Coral proves your dedication to Ironforge's master armorers. They forge you a custom breastplate for heavy frontline combat.
As a blacksmith, you can see how gnomish ingenuity joins classic dwarven metalworking to turn oceanic minerals into tempered plate.
